texts_in_order.text: FAA-Certified Drone Photography & Video in New York City

Carpio Media is a Queens-based commercial drone company serving New York City, Long Island, Westchester, New Jersey, and Connecticut. FAA Part 107 certification, 9,000+ flight hours, and an airline-aviation safety background support every production. From cinematic FPV and corporate video to events, construction, government work, and luxury real estate.
Professional NYC Drone Photography and Videography

Carpio Media works with brands, agencies, developers, production teams, property professionals, and public-sector organizations. Every project follows a safety-led workflow with clear planning, reliable communication, and polished delivery for commercial campaigns, FPV fly-throughs, construction progress, corporate stories, and events.
Aerial Drone Photography for NYC Properties and Listings

Showcase residential, commercial, and luxury properties with coordinated aerial photography, drone video, interior photography, walkthroughs, and cinematic listing content. Carpio Media serves brokers, developers, property managers, architects, and owners throughout New York and the Tri-State Area.
